blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Греки в ___ (шестой век) находили его весьма грубым.
exercises.why: «The preposition В + Prepositional is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) … (b) to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period.» — DLI, Lesson 73.
«The word "every" in time expressions answering the question "how often" … каждый день, каждое утро, каждую среду (acc.)»; «весь день, всё утро, всю неделю (accus.)». — DLI, Lessons 22, 37.

exercises.q: Я вот, кабы полегчало, опять бы по ___ (весна) пошел.
exercises.why: «The preposition по + Dat. Pl. is used to indicate that something occurs periodically.» — DLI, Lesson 74.
«The preposition ЗА + Acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.» — DLI, Lesson 77.
«The preposition НА + Prep. is used to indicate the week during which an event takes place.» — DLI, Lesson 73.
